s.t:
Bei dir sind unsere Kunden in besten Händen.
Wir sind eine B2B-Marketing- und Sales-Beratung, die ihren Kunden dabei hilft, strategische Ausrichtungen zu entwickeln, Sichtbarkeit zu erhöhen, Neukunden zu gewinnen und Sales-Prozesse zu implementieren.
Wir sind ein junges Team, arbeiten schnell und klar – und wollen wachsen.
Und genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der richtig Lust auf Verantwortung, Kundenführung und persönliche Entwicklung hat.
Klingt gut? Top – dann hätten wir da was für dich!
Aufgaben
1. Strategische Beratung & Kundenführung
Kunden charmant & souverän beraten
LinkedIn-Strategien klar vermitteln
Sicherheit geben, Humor reinbringen, Beziehung aufbauen
Mit Klarheit führen, um „Wünsch-dir-was“-Chaos zu vermeiden
2. Projektkoordination & Qualitätssicherung
Schnelle, zuverlässige & professionelle Kundenkommunikation
Betreuung von ca. 30 parallelen Kundenaccounts
Ergebnisse und Feedback klar an alle Stakeholder kommunizieren
Reportings vorbereiten und überzeugend präsentieren
3. Ergebnisse verkaufen & Upsell platzieren
Erfolge emotional aufladen und Kunden für die Entwicklung begeistern
Upsell Potenziale identifizieren („Das wäre jetzt sinnvoll für dich…“)
Weitere Offerings charmant und beratend platzieren
Qualifikation
Starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten: Du kannst Menschen abholen, verstehen und durch Gespräche führen.
Standing & Klarheit in der Beratung: Du kannst freundlich, aber bestimmt sagen, was sinnvoll ist – und was nicht.
Fachliche Erfahrung: Idealerweise hast du ein Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang abgeschlossen.
Struktur & Verlässlichkeit: Du organisierst ca. 30 Kunden ruhig, sauber und ohne Chaos.
Business-Verständnis oder Interesse daran: Du kannst dich in Geschäftsmodelle hineindenken und Kundenstrategien verstehen.
Affinität zu digitalen Tools und KI: CRM, LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Outreach Automation, ChatGPT
Lernbereitschaft & Ambition: Du willst wachsen, Verantwortung übernehmen und besser werden.

Ein Job, der dich persönlich wachsen lässt
Du wirst extrem gut im Kommunizieren
Du lernst LinkedIn durch und durch kennen
Du lernst, wie man Menschen führt
Du verstehst, wie B2B-Geschäftsmodelle funktionieren

✔️ flexible Arbeitszeiten
✔️ fancy Büro in Mainz oder Homeoffice
✔️ junges dynamisches Team (22-32 Jahre) aus High-Performern, die dich bei der Umsetzung deiner Ideen unterstützen
✔️ 1on1 Mentoring, um deine Skills entsprechend deiner Karrierewünsche auszubauen
✔️ Worcation, coole Teamevents und Top Unternehmenskultur (überzeug dich selbst: https://youtu.be/6rXz6Z51i44 )
Wenn du Verantwortung willst, Menschen magst und gerne führst statt verwaltest, dann ist diese Rolle für dich.
Du wirst schnell wachsen, viel lernen und echten Einfluss haben. Bewirb dich, wenn du bereit bist, mit einem geilen Team richtig durchzustarten.

Always Friday is an AI-driven platform that automates corporate event planning end-to-end.
The corporate events space is ripe for disruption: budgets keep growing, yet the industry still runs on outdated concierge models and software that hasn't changed in decades. Always Friday is rebuilding the agency business model itself, making event management not just easier, but setting a new standard for the industry.
With the rise of remote work, in-person events and team-building have exploded: companies need moments of connection and belonging that drive employee loyalty. We're building the full-stack AI event agency to power them.
As Enterprise Account Executive in Germany, you will own the development of Always Friday's German enterprise business and you will be our first hire in Germany. If this succeeds, you will then have the opportunity to create a team yourself and grow very very fast internally.
This is a pure enterprise hunting role: first one-off events at the beginning, and then opening and closing high-value, multi-year framework agreements with large German organisations, primarily through Procurement- and Finance-led buying processes.
Tasks
Get our first German clients
Build and execute the enterprise go-to-market strategy for the German market.
Open, manage and close long, complex sales cycles (6–12+ months) involving Procurement, Finance, Legal, Compliance and Executive stakeholders.
Negotiate and close large, multi-year framework agreements with significant annual spend.
Act as deal owner, coordinating Product, Customer Success and roll-out teams to ensure successful proofs of value and rollouts.
Drive expansion of our existing enterprise customers into the German market.
Build executive-level relationships and establish Always Friday as a credible, long-term partner in the German procurement ecosystem.
Own your pipeline, forecast accurately, and report performance with discipline and transparency.
Deliver results. This role is about opening our German Market

Sales Person: you know how to be a lone wolf but also a closer
3+ years of experience selling enterprise-grade B2B solutions to large German organisations.
Demonstrated experience managing enterprise sales cycles (6–12+ months) with multiple senior stakeholders in a key-account environment.
Experience selling into Procurement, Finance, Indirect Spend, Travel or adjacent categories.
A strong sense of ownership, discipline and execution rigor; a builder mindset: you thrive in ambiguity and create momentum.
Comfortable with the pace, intensity and mindset of a hypergrowth environment: resilience, stamina, ownership.
Native-level German and fluent English required
Experience with international or cross-border organisations is a strong plus.

Compensation : not listed. it will be the outcome of a negotiation, but expect a large compensation package for the right profile.
A culture that values results, accountability and high standards over politics.
If you succeed your career will experience a tremdous acceleration in terms of both seniority and compensation (money + stock options)

Job Description
Read this first: What this role is about
This is a client-lead role. You own client relationships and the commercial growth that comes with them. No disciplinary responsibility. At VI leading isn’t about hierarchy or reporting lines. You set direction and get people pulling towards it, but you don’t manage them on paper. Not an operational project role.

You do not manage or run projects or manage delivery day-to-day. If what energizes you is owning the client and growing the business - rather than carrying disciplinary responsibility or running project operations - you are in the right place!

The Client Relationship. You build close, trusting partnerships with a portfolio of clients and are their primary point of contact.
The Business Value. You do not just process briefings. You actively help client to uncover and solve their real business challenges.
The Order Volume. You turn business challenges of your clients into signed offers. Together with the Client Partner team you are accountable for the agency’s annual order volume.
The Account Rituals. You shape the account team rituals to create the right atmosphere, ambition and dedication to deliver outstanding results that win the clients’ hearts and minds.

A genuine pull towards owning client relationships, commercial growth and energizing the team around the client.
At least 6 yearsin client service, account management or consulting (agency side or in-house).
A completed university degree (engineering, economics or similar) or a comparable qualification.
A strategic mindset and real enthusiasm for digital topics.
Curiosity about people: You connect easily, listen closely and quickly see what matters.
Proficient English and very good written and spoken German is Mandatory.

Marion Huwatscheck

Over 50,000 customers globally trust our end-to-end, cloud-driven networking solutions. They rely on our top-rated services and support to accelerate their digital transformation efforts and deliver unprecedented progress. With double-digit growth year over year, no provider is better positioned to deliver scalable outcomes than Extreme.

We believe in “walking the walk” of our strong core values, which enable us to advance successfully together. Diversity and inclusion are vital parts of our values and beliefs, and we’re proud to foster an environment where every Extreme employee can thrive. Become part of Something big with Extreme!

As a global networking leader, learn why there’s no better time to join the Extreme team. The primary responsibilities of the Associate Account Executive include prospecting, qualifying, selling, and closing new business with existing and new clients.

In this Field Sales role , you will empower our clients to reach their full potential by understanding their strategy, unique business objectives, and desired outcomes. The ideal Associate Account Executive will be eager to further develop in sales and have a particular interest in new client acquisition.

Your profile / What you bring with you: A commercial apprenticeship or university degree (technical or business administration). Excellent Dutch and English communication skills and a strong service orientation. A good understanding of numbers and business relationships. Passion for new customer acquisition and enjoyment of sales.

Team player in a professional, cross-functional, company-wide matrix organization (sales, services, marketing, operations). At least 3 to 5 years of sales experience in the IT or network industry, including knowledge of customer acquisition, strategic customer service, and business development.

Some understanding and a strong interest in complex IT solutions and products in at least one of the technology fields of: networking, security, managed services, or software and confident handling of business metrics and calculations. Experience working in verticals such as Education, Healthcare, Local Govt and Retail are pluses.

Your Focus at Extreme End Customer Management: With your communicative and inquisitive nature, you will continually build new customer relationships and identify customer needs using all the tools Extreme provides.

Presentation: The hyper-connected world is becoming increasingly complex, but you will present the solutions to our customers in a simple and understandable way. This includes technologies such as wireless LAN, campus and data center switching, cloud management, network security, AI and analytics, and SD-WAN.

Solution Sales: You will analyze specific customer problems and develop customized solution concepts for them and present them to customers.

Offer Management: You will be responsible for creating attractive offers, with help from the larger company, which you develop in close collaboration with your extended account team and our business partners in a 100% indirect sales model. OTE is on a 50/50 split and is based on qualifications and experience 110-130K.

Extreme Networks Benefits Working Extreme & anywhere You'll receive onboarding in your local market with on-the-job training and mentoring from a local Senior Account Executive. You'll have the opportunity to work both behind the scenes and directly with customers. We work wherever it's most productive.

At Extreme, we offer a flexible hybrid model that appropriately incorporates the benefits of both remote and on-site work. Our Netherlands office is in Amstelveen. Our Netherlands team is a small but focused team, around 20 people across sales, channels, presales, services, operations and support.

Become part of our Extreme team and let's grow together! Originally posted on Himalayas

Die AdWise Media GmbH ist spezialisiert auf innovative Werbeflächen direkt am Point of Sale. Mit unserer Kassenbandwerbung bringen wir regionale Unternehmen genau dorthin, wo täglich tausende potenzielle Kunden erreicht werden – direkt an die Supermarktkasse.
Für unseren Standort in Bonn suchen wir einen erfahrenen und ambitionierten Vertriebsleiter:in / Head of Sales (m/w/d) , der Verantwortung für unser Vertriebsteam übernimmt und gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung unseren Vertrieb auf das nächste Level bringt.
Bei uns erwartet dich kein Konzern mit langen Entscheidungswegen, sondern ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit kurzen Wegen, viel Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.
Aufgaben
Als Vertriebsleiter übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Performance unseres Vertriebsteams – und bleibst gleichzeitig selbst aktiv im Verkauf.

Führung, Coaching und Weiterentwicklung unseres Vertriebsteam
Eigenständiges Führen von Verkaufsgesprächen und Abschluss von Neukund
Verantwortung für einen eigenen monatlichen Umsatz als Closer
Übernahme qualifizierter und bereits terminierter Verkaufsgespräch
Verantwortung für die Erreichung der individuellen und teamweiten Umsatzziel
Steuerung unserer Setter und Closer anhand klar definierter KPI
Regelmäßige Analyse von Calls und gezieltes Coaching der Vertriebsmitarbeite
Durchführung von Sales-Meetings, 1:1s und Performance Review
Analyse von Terminquote, Show-Rate, Closing-Rate, Durchschnittsumsatz und weiteren Sales-KPI
Optimierung des gesamten Vertriebsprozesses vom Erstkontakt bis zum Vertragsabschlus
Weiterentwicklung von Sales-Skripten, Einwandbehandlung und Closing-Strategie
Sicherstellung einer sauberen CRM-Pipeline sowie verlässlicher Forecast
Recruiting, Onboarding und Einarbeitung neuer Vertriebsmitarbeiter
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung bei Vertriebsstrategie und Skalierung
Nutzung und Weiterentwicklung von KI- und Automatisierungslösungen im Vertrieb
Die Position ist ausdrücklich als Playing-Coach-Rolle gedacht: Du führst das Team, entwickelst unsere Vertriebsstrukturen weiter und gehst gleichzeitig selbst als Vorbild in Verkaufsgespräche. Wir suchen keinen reinen Sales Manager, sondern jemanden, der Führung und operativen Vertrieb miteinander verbindet.
Qualifikation
Du passt zu uns, wenn du bereits nachweislich erfolgreich im B2B-Vertrieb abgeschlossen hast und jetzt zusätzlich Verantwortung für ein Vertriebsteam übernehmen möchtest.

Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb
Nachweisbare Erfolge im telefonischen bzw. digitalen Closing
Erfahrung mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten oder Dienstleistungen von Vorteil
Führungserfahrung oder nachweisbare Erfahrung im Coaching von Vertriebsmitarbeitern
Ausgeprägte Abschluss- und Verhandlungsstärke
Fähigkeit, selbst konstant Umsatz zu generieren und gleichzeitig die Performance eines Teams zu steigern
Starkes Verständnis für KPIs, Sales Funnels und performanceorientierte Vertriebssteuerung
Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen und strukturiertem Pipeline-Management
Unternehmerisches und zahlenorientiertes Denken
Hoher eigener Leistungsanspruch und Hands-on-Mentalität
Fähigkeit, klare Erwartungen zu formulieren und konsequent nachzuhalten
Interesse an KI, Automatisierung und modernen Sales-Technologien
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse
Ein Studium ist für uns nicht entscheidend. Für uns zählen deine bisherigen Vertriebsergebnisse, deine Abschlussstärke und deine Fähigkeit, andere Verkäufer besser zu machen.

Attraktives Fixgehalt plus leistungsorientierte Vergütung
Direkter Einfluss auf die Entwicklung und Skalierung unseres Unternehmens
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung
Viel Verantwortung und echte Entscheidungsfreiheit
Kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien
Modernes Büro in Bonn
Moderne Vertriebs-, CRM- und KI-Tools
Strukturierte Prozesse und ein bestehendes Vertriebsteam
Persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung
Regelmäßige Team-Events
Getränke und Verpflegung im Büro
Perspektive, mit dem Wachstum des Unternehmens auch die eigene Verantwortung weiter auszubauen
Wir suchen jemanden, der Vertrieb wirklich lebt .
Jemanden, der morgens nicht nur Reports kontrolliert, sondern versteht, warum ein Team seine Zahlen erreicht und warum nicht. Du erkennst Probleme im Funnel, coachst Mitarbeiter gezielt und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns Strukturen, mit denen wir nachhaltig wachsen können.
Wenn du bereits erfolgreich im Vertrieb gearbeitet hast, Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und Lust hast, einen bestehenden Vertrieb aktiv weiterzuentwickeln, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.
Bewirb dich bei uns und werde ein zentraler Bestandteil der nächsten Wachstumsphase von AdWise Media.

At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally.

Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.
When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light.

You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
Enterprise Account Executive - DACH
Why We Have This Role
Qualtrics is on the lookout for a proactive, collaborative seller that can help us lead and own the strategy for selling Experience Management (XM) SaaS within the largest accounts in the DACH market. We’re helping the world’s leading companies improve experiences.

Our solutions allow our clients to have a 360° view of the entire experience enabling them to uncover what matters most to clients and employees with the ability to take action in real time.

In the Enterprise Sales role, you will be working with Major Accounts with an overarching objective to drive company revenue growth through net new customer acquisition and expansion in our current customer base.

This person will work collaboratively to meet sales goals and deliver the highest standard of integrity, quality, and customer service to our clients.
How You’ll Find Success
Relationship Building: Master stakeholder mapping to cultivate relationships with multiple contacts within an account, ensuring lasting partnerships.
Negotiation Skills: Navigate negotiations with professionalism, understanding the art of give-and-take.
Multi-Selling Approach: Drive engagement with various business stakeholders in parallel to create multifaceted selling opportunities.
Empathetic Competitiveness: While being competitive, possess the ability to empathise and understand others’ perspectives.
Entrepreneurial Mindset: Take initiative to grasp the expected outcomes and context, working independently to drive results.
Effective Communication: Influence effectively at all levels, creating trust and collaboration within the team.
How You’ll Grow
By joining Qualtrics, you become part of a revolutionary team committed to shaping groundbreaking experiences.
You will help us expand the XM category beyond where it is today with more advanced use cases & pioneering advancements in AI.
Our mission is to build technology that positively impacts businesses and makes them more human.
As a member of our global sales organisation, you will take ownership of a dedicated territory and develop robust strategies designed to drive demand and revenue.
We foster an environment that encourages big-picture thinking, innovation, and creativity, enabling you to build relationships with multiple decision-makers and articulate the unique value proposition of Qualtrics.
Things You’ll Do
Focus on acquiring new business and sell the Qualtrics Platform to key accounts.
Develop comprehensive account plans, from power maps to demand generation and closing strategies.
Manage relationships between Qualtrics and senior executives of both client and prospect companies.
Strategising internally with SDRs (sales development representatives), solutions consultants, partners etc to create demand and drive senior engagement in accounts.
Gain a thorough understanding of prospects' business issues and industry challenges to craft tailored solutions.
Build compelling business cases that demonstrate clear ROI and value for clients.
Maintaining a real-time understanding of Qualtrics' offerings and the competitive landscape to provide win-based proposals and pricing strategies.

s.h: What We’re Looking For On Your Resume
s.t:
Significant experience selling SaaS solutions, and experience in discussing strategic business issues at Director and C level in Large Enterprise accounts.
Significant demonstrated success in driving and navigating C-level engagement & connections at the highest level.
Significant experience in leading, planning and closing 7 figure deals.
Significant experience in owning the full commercial capacity of Strategic Accounts.
Strong track record in achieving and exceeding sales quotas.
Ability to be creative in driving engagement with new contacts within an account.
Fluency in German and English.
You are passionate about educating potential clients on solutions relevant to their situation and helping them understand how the software can drive a return on investment for them.
You can leverage your network in the market to generate interest in Qualtrics solutions.
You have a desire to manage a territory like running your own consultancy.
You engage with clients at all points of the sales cycle - from prospecting and acquiring clients, through demoing the Qualtrics product, to negotiating and closing, and beyond.
You have the agility to adapt, pivot and change your approach based on the needs of your business.
You partner well with internal teams and bring together internal resources that enable successful closure of deals.
What You Should Know About This Team
Qualtrics global sales team is dedicated to changing the way our customers focus on experiences. Forrester reports that companies generate a 674% return on investment when using Qualtrics. Now that's a solution you can get behind.
As an Enterprise Sales professional, you will focus on new revenue through strategic, relationship-based selling. Our most successful sales employees have a track record of exceeding quotas, acting as trusted advisors to clients and being passionate teammates.
The Qualtrics platform is versatile, adding value to a limitless array of decision makers. If you love a strategic, analytics sales process working with a variety of industries, departments and buyers, selling Qualtrics XM will always keep you learning and growing.
Challenges excite us, as we view them as opportunities for growth and positive transformation.
We are not merely observers of change; we actively initiate and drive it.

s.h: Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits
s.t:
Qualtrics Experience Program - A bonus each year for an experience of your choosing
Worldwide and diverse community that enjoys helping each other
At Qualtrics we are constantly working to create an environment where everyone feels safe and comfortable coming to work and can, as a result of our culture, make their best possible contribution to our team
The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model : While this role is exempt from working in office, our hybrid work model remains elegantly simple for the rest of the company: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader.

These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote

At OpenUp, we believe mental well-being should be as accessible and normal as going to the gym. Our mission is simple but ambitious: to make mental well-being available to everyone.
We partner with companies to support their employees and families through proactive, practical mental health services. Our platform brings together 1:1 check-ins, courses, content, group sessions, and mindfulness practices - all supported by a dedicated network of experts. We take a holistic view, connecting mental and physical well-being through lifestyle coaching focused on sleep, nutrition, and exercise.
Today, we support over 1,500 companies and 500,000+ employees globally, including Rituals, Deloitte, Decathlon, KPMG, and McDonald’s. Recognised as a Top 3 LinkedIn Startup in 2023, 2024 and 2025 - and we've got big plans to keep growing our client-base, which is where this role comes into play.

We’re growing our presence in the DACH market and are looking for entrepreneurial, purpose-driven Account Executives to help build this market with us.
In this role, you own the full sales cycle end-to-end - from identifying opportunities and opening conversations, through to closing deals and building long-term relationships. This is not a “plug-and-play” sales role; it’s an opportunity to shape how we grow in DACH.
You’ll work closely with our Business Development, Customer Success, and Marketing teams as part of a collaborative, international commercial team.

Drive new business by identifying and engaging potential clients across the DACH region
Build and expand a strong network of B2B partnerships
Grow existing accounts by spotting expansion opportunities (including international rollouts)
Act as a trusted first point of contact for your customers

s.h: What you'll bring to our team
s.t:
You genuinely enjoy working with people; you’re energised by conversations, building relationships, and connecting with stakeholders at different levels.
You bring a combination of drive, curiosity, and resilience. You take ownership, learn from setbacks, and continuously look for ways to improve. You’re comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and enjoy being part of a team that builds together.
Mental well-being resonates with you as something that matters and something you want to contribute to.

3+ years of experience in sales (ideally B2B SaaS or high-growth environments)
Strong relationship-building skills - you’re a natural, confident and engaging networker
Experience - or interest - in building a network within HR or People teams
Proven success in closing deals with medium- to large-enterprises
A structured, action-oriented way of working and a relationship-focussed sales approach
Enthusiasm for working in a highly dynamic, AI-forward international environment
Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, or Pipedrive
Fluent language skills in both German and English

s.h: What you'll get as part of our team
s.t: You’ll join a company that combines commercial ambition with meaningful impact. We move fast, support each other, and make time to celebrate along the way.

s.h: Alongside a competitive salary and bonus structure, we offer
s.t:
€1500 annual personal development budget
Contribution to your ClassPass membership
€50 monthly internet/phone allowance
Daily healthy, vegetarian lunch at the office
Regular yoga, meditation, and breathing sessions
Flexible hybrid working model
Monthly drinks, summer events, ski trips, and padel tournaments
27.5 vacation days per year
Free and unlimited access to OpenUp for you and your family, including sessions with psychologists

Inspired to be part of OpenUp? We’d love to hear your story. Apply via our website and we’ll get in touch soon.
If you have questions, please visit our FAQ page or reach out directly.
At OpenUp, everyone is welcome to apply regardless of age, gender, background, nationality, or any other characteristic. What matters to us is high performance, a real drive to make an impact and the ambition to become the European market leader. If you're ready to OpenUp, join us!

All hiring decisions are made by humans. If you would like more information about how we use AI in the process, please contact us.

We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!
Your Opportunity
Join our team as an Senior Account Executive, where you'll focus exclusively on introducing New Relic to new customers in the Nordic region. You'll build relationships with potential new clients , listen to their challenges, and show them how our solutions can help their business succeed.

Über uns
Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser .
In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.
Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.
Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.
VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).
Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:
Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.
Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.
Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.
Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.
About the Venture
We build frontier artificial intelligence that helps governments and defence organisations make sense of a fast-moving information environment. Our systems help the teams responsible for national security read a complex information environment faster and clearer than ever before. We've closed a pre-seed round and are already running live government pilots, with plans to expand across Europe and beyond. This is an early, venture-backed company doing work that carries weight.

This is a founding role for our expansion across the DACH region and the Nordics. You will own how we grow here, from the first conversation through to a signed contract, building the region much as we built the UK: learning the landscape, opening doors, landing pilots and turning them into long-term contracts.

You will work closely with the founders and with a forward-deployed engineer who builds the tools, integrations and prototypes that a live sales process needs, so your job is to win the room, work out what the customer actually needs, and direct that build until the deal closes.

Own go-to-market across the DACH region and the Nordics, winning and growing contracts across government, defence and large enterprise, from first conversation through to close.
Map the region from a blank slate, find the advisory relationships that open doors, and build a network where we do not have one yet.
Land pilots and turn them into long-term contracts, working from first engagements towards enterprise deals worth seven figures a year.
Turn customer needs into scoped solutions, briefing and directing a forward-deployed engineer to stand up the reports, dashboards, integrations and prototypes that move deals forward.
Build the regional playbook from first principles: pipeline, qualification, pricing and close.
Make complex technology clear and convincing to senior decision-makers in government and defence.
Work directly with the founders on strategy, positioning and the deals that matter most.

You are, at heart, someone who likes to build something from nothing. You are at your best finding the first contacts, earning their trust, and turning a cold market into real relationships and real deals. You are hands-on, as comfortable doing the sourcing and outreach yourself as sitting across from a senior decision-maker on a sensitive brief, and you understand that this kind of work is slow, careful and built on trust.
A real appetite for business development: you like winning deals, opening relationships and building a market from scratch, and you keep going long after an inherited network has run dry.
Enough of a technical background to scope solutions, brief an engineer and hold your own with technical buyers.
The drive to build a process from nothing rather than run one that already exists.
Fluency in the region: strong English and at least one relevant regional language, with German a clear advantage.
Comfort in an early startup, where there is real ownership, quick decisions and plenty of ambiguity.
Discretion and integrity, because our work depends on a high level of trust.
A background in defence, national security or another setting where you have earned trust and done deals with government is a strong advantage.
Eligibility for security clearance is an advantage.

This is a launching role with a whole region to own, at an early, venture-backed company that has already closed a pre-seed round and is running live pilots with government. You will work alongside the founders, with founder-level access and ownership from the start, and the market you build will be yours to shape.

The work is demanding and it matters, for clients operating at a high level on problems that are genuinely difficult. For the person who builds this well, there is meaningful equity and real upside.

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt for Work is a rapidly-growing B2B business at Wolt, and we have ambitious plans to massively accelerate this growth. Our mission is simple: we want to bring the same great user experience that Wolt is known for to business users around the world.

Through Wolt’s established delivery network and vast number of restaurant and retail partners, Wolt for Work enables businesses to boost their employees’ happiness no matter where they are working, promote camaraderie in teams, and save time and effort running office events.

We are already live in 16 of Wolt’s 23 countries, with no plans to slow down.

Full end-to-end responsibility over the sales acquisition funnel, from A-Z within the enterprise market.
Own the full sales cycle for inbound and outbound opportunities, including prospecting, negotiation, and closing partnership agreements across enterprise and SMB customers.
Acting as problem-solver for prospects’ needs and working with internal stakeholders to formulate solutions for them.
Working closely with Account Managers to ensure consistent and optimal outcomes for the business and for clients.
Working with our Marketing team to develop partnerships, attend events and create an acquisition funnel.
Our humble expectations
Experience in sales, account management, business development and/or partnerships in B2B enterprise fields. Startup or Scaleup experience is a plus.
Ambition - lots of it - and strong inner motivation paired with a positive mindset (it's the key to hitting targets)
Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to adapt communication to suit the audience.
Structured and analytical problem-solver with a drive for taking action when necessary
Natural tendency for ownership with a get-stuff-done, entrepreneurial attitude
Organized and structured way of working, including working with CRMs.
Tenacity and creativity to approach and solve clients’ problems.
True culture champion who rolls-up-his/her sleeves, exemplifies teamwork, and drives decision-making with data. We also value humbleness and politeness at all times!
Excellent communication and presentation skills in German and English.

High growth, startup, or scaleup experience
Experience with marketplace businesses
Experience in marketing, operations, logistics, or customer success
Proficiency in one or more analytics & visualization tools (e.g. Excel, G Suite, Looker)

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then and get the conversation going!

TechQuartier For 10 years, TechQuartier has been the place in Frankfurt am Main, Germany, where the right people come together through events, programs, and accelerator initiatives to drive innovative growth.

As a key driver of innovation in Frankfurt’s financial center, TechQuartier connects FinTech and GreenTech startup founders with established companies in future-shaping fields such as AI, quantum computing, and finance. TechQuartier has been part of the Federal Digital Hub Initiative (de:hub) since its start in 2017.

In 2024, TechQuartier was officially recognized as the FinTech Hub Frankfurt within the de:hub network. TechQuartier is also the organizer and host of the IMPACT FESTIVAL in Frankfurt – Germanys largest B2B event for digital & sustainable transformation.

TechQuartier continues to advance the startup ecosystem in the Frankfurt Rhine-Main region and strengthens its role as a central innovation hotspot in Europe.
If you’re interested in taking on responsibility in a dynamic environment, contributing your own ideas, and driving innovation together with us, you’ve come to the right place.
Join our team full-time starting from january 2027 . We look forward to receiving your application.
Why this role truly makes an impact The IMPACT FESTIVAL brings together companies, start-ups, investors, and innovators to drive digital and sustainable transformation forward. To make this happen, it takes strong partners and a diverse range of exhibitors.
As a (Senior) Sales Manager , you will play a key role in acquiring new exhibitors, sponsors, and partners for the IMPACT FESTIVAL. With your instinct for business opportunities and your strong closing skills, you will directly contribute to the festival’s growth and economic success.

This role is not just about managing existing accounts, but about actively creating new opportunities, acquiring a high number of exhibitors, convincing partners, and consistently driving the sales process through to contract signing.
What you will drive forward with us You are responsible for selling our exhibitor, trade fair, sponsorship, and partnership offerings, from identifying and approaching potential customers through negotiation to contract signing.
You build a sustainable sales pipeline by combining inbound leads with proactive outbound activities to acquire new customers.
You develop existing customer relationships, identify cross- and upselling opportunities, and build long-term partnerships.
Together with the team, you further develop our sales strategy and pricing structure and identify new market opportunities.
You confidently lead negotiations with decision-makers, with a strong focus on closing deals, and develop tailored offers.
You ensure a structured handover to the onboarding and account management process and support it as needed.
You manage and document your sales activities in our CRM (Pipedrive) and use the data gained to manage, analyze, and optimize the pipeline.
You work closely with the IMPACT FESTIVAL team and other relevant departments at TechQuartier, ensuring smooth coordination and collaboration.
What you bring to the table You have several years of experience in B2B sales, ideally in the trade fair, conference, event, or sponsorship industry.
You have a proven track record in acquiring new customers and experience in successfully driving complex sales processes through to closing.
You have a strong understanding of customer needs and market potential and bring experience in developing, implementing, and optimizing sales strategies and pricing structures.
You are a strong communicator, approachable, and confident when interacting with a wide range of stakeholders. You communicate fluently in both German and English.
You have strong negotiation skills, take initiative, and work in a structured and goal-oriented manner, while keeping track of multiple sales processes running in parallel.
You are eager to learn and bring a hands-on mentality and a solution-oriented approach.
You are confident working with CRM systems; experience with Pipedrive is a plus.
You are passionate about sustainability, digitalization, and innovation.
Not required, but definitely helpful
You have experience working in a startup or coworking environment and are familiar with the dynamics of agile work cultures.
What awaits you with us Team-Spirit: We are an open‑minded, dedicated, and international team that truly embraces innovation and entrepreneurship. To spark new and creative solutions, we value diverse opinions and perspectives.
Innovation Hub: You will work in a modern and inspiring environment at the heart of Frankfurt’s start‑up ecosystem. Through constant exchange with start‑ups, you’ll discover new trends and technologies, build valuable connections, and take part in numerous events at TechQuartier.
Ownership: From day one, you’ll take responsibility for your own projects, make decisions, and actively shape the future of TechQuartier.
Career & Development: We foster a transparent learning and feedback culture. Clear career levels, skill profiles, and plenty of room for your own ideas help you strengthen your talents and grow personally and professionally.
Flexibility: With your own laptop and a Deutschlandticket, you’re well equipped. Thanks to the option to work partially remote and flexible working hours within our core time, you can organize your day in the way that makes you most productive.
Benefits: 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve, New Year’s Eve, and your birthday; a company pension plan; shopping and fitness discounts; regular team events; and free drinks.

Albert helps chemists change the world by building technology that understands how they work. As chemists ourselves, we know what it’s like when software doesn’t work the way you do — stuck with systems built by people who never spent a day at the bench. That’s why we created Albert OS, the first AI-native operating system for materials science, designed to remove every obstacle between curiosity and discovery.
We’re looking for an ambitious and results-driven Strategic Account Executive to join our growing team. This role, with a focus on driving high-value, consultative sales across Germany and the broader EU region, will play a key part in driving successful outcomes for Albert’s most strategically important customers and internal initiatives.
If you’re passionate about cutting-edge technology and thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment, we want to hear from you.
You’ll take full ownership of pipeline generation and deal strategy for chemical, materials science, life sciences, and pharmaceutical companies across Germany and the EU region, drawing on an existing senior network in these sectors to open doors and build trust quickly. Strategy & Delivery
Own pipeline generation and deal strategy end-to-end for Germany and the DACH region, proactively building and prioritizing your own book of business rather than waiting for leads or direction.
Translate deep knowledge of chemistry, materials science, and life sciences R&D workflows into a point of view that resonates with technical and executive buyers.
Prepare accurate pipeline forecasts and account plans, and report progress against goals to sales leadership.

Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles in large accounts, consistently exceeding quota through consultative, value- and revenue-led selling rather than feature-led pitches.
Engage at the C-level as a trusted advisor, leveraging an existing senior network across chemical, materials science, and life sciences companies to build credibility quickly.
Work cross-functionally with Solutions Scientists, Customer Engagement, and Marketing to shape proposals, demos, and account strategy.
Negotiate contracts, pricing, and terms that balance long-term partner success with Albert’s commercial goals.
Leadership & Impact
Act as the voice of the partner inside Albert, feeding market and product feedback to marketing, product and leadership.
Represent Albert at industry conferences and events across Germany and the DACH region.
Collaborate with Solutions Scientists and other pre and post sales stakeholders effectively

10+ years of experience in sales or account management, ideally within SaaS, enterprise software, or scientific/R&D solutions.
A strong, existing senior network in the chemical, materials science, life sciences, and pharmaceutical sectors.
Credible knowledge of AI solutions that drive enterprise business value
Proven enterprise SaaS or AI sales experience, with a track record of navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles in large accounts and consistently exceeding quota.
A proactive “hunter” mindset — someone who takes full ownership of pipeline generation and deal strategy rather than waiting for direction.
C-level presence and consultative selling skills, acting as a trusted advisor and focusing on value and revenue impact rather than feature-led selling or pure logo acquisition.
High personal autonomy and resilience, able to operate effectively in a fast-changing startup environment with evolving product, pricing, and internal structures.
Fluent in German and English, with the ability to work effectively across both languages with internal teams and partners.
Proficiency with CRM tools and standard sales processes like MEDDPICC and value selling motions
Willingness to travel across Germany and the broader DACH/European region as needed.

Grit: Self-starter, persistent problem solver, relentless in their pursuit of progress.
Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
Adaptability: Comfortable in dynamic, evolving customer and company environments.
Innovator: Passionate about improving customer outcomes through digital tools and scientific rigor.
Empathy: Strong active listening across multiple personas and cultures.
Leadership: Ability to lead initiatives and drive projects to completion with little or no oversight.
Why Albert?
We have a huge impact. Albert is a growing team with a global reach. We’re building toward a future where discovery feels like exploration, not administration. Where chemists can pursue their most ambitious ideas without friction. We love our global team.

Albert’s home-base is in the California Bay Area, but we have multiple offices and employees sprinkled around the globe: India, Germany and Japan. In fact, over 50% of our employees work outside of California! An international hybrid culture is in our DNA. We care about you.

Albert works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We work hard and we play hard. We value diversity. Growing and maintaining our inclusive and diverse team matters to us.

We are committed to being a company where our employees feel comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work and have the ability to be successful — every day. We’re always looking for humble, sharp, and creative folks to join the Albert team. If you think you might be a fit, please apply!

About Alma
At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place: serving merchants and consumers.
Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.
As the buy now, pay later leader in France and an active player in 10 European countries, we have empowered more than 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.
With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ in ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we are just getting started!

This position is for a CDR based in Paris.
You will join Alma’s SMB Sales team, made up of more than 20 people, and more specifically our four-person Inbound team.
As the team continues to grow alongside Alma, you will have the opportunity to leverage your sales skills while continuing to learn, develop and receive support from experienced teammates. Your goal will be to become the best sales professional you can be, with the support of the wider Revenue organization.
You will also work alongside a European, multilingual and multi-country Revenue organization of more than 80 people, giving you the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues across markets and cultures.

Since Alma was founded in 2019, the Inbound team has been a key pillar of our commercial growth. As an Inbound Account Executive , you will play a central role in helping SMB merchants across France and Europe discover, adopt and grow with Alma.
Your mission will be to turn inbound opportunities into long-term commercial relationships, from the first conversation to the first transaction.
Own the inbound sales cycle: qualify, understand and convert leads from different sources, focusing on merchants with less than €5 million in annual revenue.
Build and manage your pipeline: organize your time, prioritize opportunities and manage every lead from qualification through to the first sale.
Deliver consistent performance: work towards monthly, quarterly and annual targets while maintaining a high level of execution and delivering an excellent customer experience.
Master the art of selling: continuously sharpen your discovery, sales, negotiation and closing techniques through practice, coaching and feedback.
Become a trusted expert: develop a deep understanding of the retail, e-commerce, finance and payments industries, both in France and across Europe.
Grow with Alma: contribute to the continued development of the Inbound team and help shape the way we support and convert the next generation of Alma merchants.
This role is ideal for someone ambitious, curious and eager to take ownership, grow quickly and make a tangible impact on Alma’s growth.
You will work with
As an Inbound Account Executive , you’ll work with a range of tools to manage your activity, improve your sales performance and better understand our merchants:
Salesforce: our CRM, where you’ll manage your leads, pipeline and sales activity.
Gong: to automate parts of your workflow, record your calls and review them to continuously improve your sales techniques.
Aircall: to manage your day-to-day calls with prospects and merchants.
Slack: to communicate directly with your colleagues and collaborate across teams.
Google Workspace: for the day-to-day productivity and collaboration tools used across the team.
Looker: to access and analyze business and sales data.
Additional retail and merchant intelligence tools: you’ll discover these over time, alongside the wider teams, to deepen your understanding of our market and prospects.

To succeed in this job
Humility: you learn from your mistakes, welcome feedback and continuously improve alongside the team.
Autonomy: you can quickly take ownership of your pipeline, manage your opportunities and convert merchants independently.
Curiosity: you’re eager to understand the retail, e-commerce, finance and payments ecosystems in which Alma operates, and become a recognized expert in these areas.
Rigor: you pay attention to every step of the sales cycle and maintain high standards to deliver sustainable performance and exceed your targets.
And it would be a plus if you also
Language skills: you are bilingual in English and either bilingual or a native speaker of Spanish or German .
Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.
What’s in it for you
If you join us, you will have the opportunity to grow and make an impact through:
A true sales school: learn every day alongside experienced sales professionals and develop the skills, habits and mindset to build a successful career in one of France’s leading tech companies.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions.

Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital.

Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
The Opportunity
Grafana Labs is looking for an Commercial Account Executive, Acquisition based in Switzerland who will be responsible for prospecting and closing new business across Switzerland and Austria. You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data.

We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team.

Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before.
What You’ll Be Doing
Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals
Outbound prospecting into net-new customers
Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, and negotiations)
Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads
Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise
Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce
Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests

s.h: What Makes You a Great Fit
s.t:
2+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales
Previous experience selling to companies based in Switzerland and/or Austria
Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer)
Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player
Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies
You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually
Fluent in English & German (both written and spoken)

French language skills
Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage
Experience using Salesforce
Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal
